summary: One documented method can throw for an accepted null input, and one cache detail is imprecisely worded.

items.issue: `Symbol.apply(null)` is accepted by the implementation, producing a symbol whose `hashCode` throws `NullPointerException` when it calls `name.hashCode()`. The documentation unconditionally says it returns a hash code.
items.suggestion: Document the null case and its `NullPointerException`, or establish and document a non-null-name precondition at construction/application.

items.issue: The weak reference's referent (the cached value), not the map entry itself, is garbage-collected while the entry remains associated with a live key.
items.suggestion: Say “a cached value that has been garbage collected is reconstructed on the next lookup.”
